<b>Flintslate</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When used, it briefly increases the damage of Hornet's [[Needle]].

== Usefulness ==
Using Flintslate imbues [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Needle]] with fire, causing it to deal 50% extra damage for 8 seconds. Activating the Flintslate briefly pauses Hornet's movement even if she's in the air, similarly to [[Bind]]ing. 

After Hornet hits an enemy between 2-5 times in a row while Flintslate is active, the enemy will catch on fire and take 3 ticks of burning damage. There is a 20% chance for it to take between 2-5 blows; otherwise it will take between 3-4. <ref group=Source><code>DamageEnemies.DoEnemyDamageNailImbuement()</code> in <code>Assembly-CSharp.dll</code>.</ref>

[[Crafting Kit]]s do not affect this Tool in any way.

* Burning damage scales with Needle upgrades: it deals 1 damage per tick when Hornet has no Needle upgrades, 2 damage when she has one, 3 damage when she has two or three, and 4 damage when she has four. Successfully reigniting an already burning enemy resets the duration of the burning effect to the maximum.
* Upon use, Flintslate immediately removes 25% of the frosting effect from [[Mount Fay]], and then slows the effect down by 30% while the buff is active.
* The Flintslate's buff instantly ends if Hornet falls into water.
* It is especially useful in combination with [[Flea Brew]], as you will be able to attack more while Flintslate's damage multiplier is active.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in [[Deep Docks]], to the west of the lowest entrance from [[Far Fields]]. The Flintslate sits on a workbench in a small room, at the top of a tall chamber of hanging platforms.

== Trivia ==
* Flintslate has a unique interaction while standing in the showers left of the [[Citadel Spa]], where Hornet's needle will release water vapour when the Tool's effect is active.
** This interaction is disabled if Pollip Pouch is applied.
* According to its item description, the Flintslate is made out of cut and polished [[Flintgem]].
* The [[Clawline]], last 3 hits of the [[Architect Crest]]'s down-slash and sprint-slash, the second hit of the [[Witch Crest]]'s down slash as well as the third extra hit of its sprint-slash, are all unaffected by the Flintslate.
** However, these things are affected by other damage modifiers.
